NOTICE OF A REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING
October 27, 2026, at 6:00 PM

PUBLIC NOTICE is hereby given that the Vineyard City Council will hold a regularly scheduled City Council meeting on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, at 6:00 PM, in the City Council Chambers at City Hall, 125 South Main Street, Vineyard, UT. This meeting can also be viewed on our live stream page.

AGENDA

1.	CALL TO ORDER

2.	INVOCATION AND PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE (BY INVITATION)

3.	PUBLIC COMMENTS (3 MINUTES PER PERSON)
        'Public Comments' is defined as time set aside for citizens to express their views. Public comments can be submitted ahead of time to robinr@vineyardutah.gov.

4.	RECOGNITIONS
        4.1.	Recognize the Public Works Team for Their Dedication and Hard Work in Extraordinary Circumstances.

5.	WORK SESSION
        5.1   Discussion on Vineyard City's Fleet (Evan Smith and George Schramm - 15 Minutes)

6.	CONSENT ITEMS
        6.1.	Approval of the October 13, 2026, City Council Meeting Minutes
        6.2.	Approve ORD 2026-11 SB 284 ADU (Accessory Dwelling Units) Compliance
        6.3.	Accept Resolution 2026-37 Selling of Insignificant Land Parcel B
        6.4.	Accept Resolution 2026-38 Selling of Insignificant Land Parcel H
        6.5.	Accept Resolution 2026-39 Selling of Insignificant Land Parcels T

7.	BUSINESS ITEMS
        7.1.	Approve Resolution 2026 - 43 Flock Safety (Requested by Council Member Jacob Wood - 5 Minutes)

8.	ADJOURN TO A CLOSED SESSION
	To discuss pending or reasonably imminent litigation; the character or professional competence of an individual; the purchase or lease of real property; or to discuss a matter permitted under UCA § 52-4-205.

       8.1   Approve and set a date, time, and location for a closed meeting for a strategy session to discuss the purchase, exchange, or lease of real property, including any form of a water right or water shares, or to discuss a proposed development agreement, project proposal, or financing proposal related to the development of land owned by the state or a political subdivision.

        8.2   Approve and Set a Date, Time, and Location for a Closed Meeting to Discuss the Character, Professional Competence, or Physical or Mental Health of an Individual or Individuals, for Today's Date, at this Location, Following the Completion of the Regular Agenda. (Two items requested by Council Member Jake Holdaway - 15 minutes)

        8.3   Approve and Set a Date, Time, and Location for a Closed Meeting for a Strategy Session to Discuss Pending or Reasonably Imminent Litigation for Today's Date, at this Location, Following the Completion of the Regular Agenda. (One item requested by Council Member Jake Holdaway - 7 minutes)

9.	ADJOURNMENT

STAFF REPORT
Meeting
October 27, 2026
Date:
Agenda
Discussion on Vineyard City's Fleet (Evan Smith and George Schramm - 15
Item:
Minutes)
Department: Finance and Public Works
Presenter: Evan Smith, George Schramm
Background/Discussion:
The Umpqua or Unified lease of 10 vehicles was intended to be exited just prior to the annual
payment due in February 2027. There are several options, including everything from buying the
current vehicles to reducing the number of vehicles and entering into a new lease with the dealer
buying back the current leased vehicles.
This discussion is to answer questions from the council on this lease and discuss some potential
options with the lease and the fleet prior to the February 2027 deadline.
Fiscal Impact:
A budget amendment will be required once the council determines which option to address the
current lease and fleet requirements.
Recommendation:
Staff recommends exiting the current lease and selling back the vehicles on the current lease and
entering into a new lease with more favorable terms and fewer vehicles based on a
comprehensive review of current fleet needs.
Sample Motion:
N/A - discussion only this work session
